title: A video channel, an audio and video channel and a conference channel each bind as a transport of their type, carrying their media
notes: The implementation's own video channel (video.open), audio and video channel (av.open) and conference channel (conference.open). Their bindings show the VIDEO, AUDIO_VIDEO and CONFERENCE rows of the §6.2 table (a transport) and the Video, Audio/Video and Conference rows of the §6.3 table, the media types matched in any order, which the RFC does not fix. Cited in part: no fixture builds a realtime audio and video channel, the REALTIME_AUDIO_VIDEO row of §6.2 and the Realtime Audio/Video row of §6.3; voice/a-voice-and-a-realtime-channel-bind-as-transports-of-audio-and-text shows the VOICE and REALTIME_VOICE rows. The Key Features column describes what the channel does, which the scenarios of §12.8 and §12.10 observe.
